description: Boxes with per-side border overrides and the frame they draw. Core's Box.test.ts renders each row with BoxRenderable, and the Rust crate's tests/widgets.rs with View, so both bindings draw the same frame. Each row is [name, box, rows, foreground]: the box fills a screen of its width and height; rows are the screen's text with trailing spaces trimmed; in foreground each letter names a color in palette and '.' is not checked.
rows: mixed corners, side colors and titles
sides off: the top runs through, the left reaches the bottom
